name: aws-cloudtrail-digest
producer: AWS CloudTrail log file integrity validation (digest files)
description: The strongest thing in the comparison set. Each hourly digest carries previousDigestHashValue over the previous digest FILE, so deleting a digest is detectable, and an hour with no activity still produces a digest with logFiles: [] — a rare explicit 'nothing this interval' assertion. But the chain is over FILES, not events: no per-event ordinal, no dropped-event count anywhere in the product, and scope (management vs data vs network-activity events) is declared in the trail's EventSelector configuration rather than in the evidence.

integrity.primitive: SHA-256 + SHA256withRSA over the digest object (signature in S3 object metadata)

coverage.note: EventSelector/AdvancedEventSelector define coverage out of band, in trail config.

independence.boundary_statement: Produced by the AWS control plane, outside every audited principal. It witnesses API calls to AWS and nothing that happens inside an instance or container.
